title: Native content
role: The actual document, world, data or task owns the visual field.
cropRules: Keep dynamic text, controls and values native to the implementation.
provenance: Use owned/sample data with explicit provenance; no decorative fake metrics.
delivery: Choose actual output dimensions and format from the display role.
Use responsive sources and avoid blocking the primary action on nonessential art.
Record bytes, dimensions, source and transformations in the project asset manifest.
